tracks.title: The Stardust Engine
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Opens the coastal homecoming concert under the sweeping white pavilion canopy of the **CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater** as 20,000 fans across the pavilion and sloped grass lawn roar along.

tracks.title: Neon Pulse
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Nocturnal highway synth-rock from 2001's *Midnight Drivers* pulsing across the Virginia Beach summer night.

tracks.title: Midnight Drivers
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: The title anthem of the 2001–2002 world tour performed in the O'Connell and Wright family's original coastal hometown.

tracks.title: Hard Reset
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Heavy 1980s-rooted arena rock cutting across the pavilion and lawn of the CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater.

tracks.title: Garbage
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Raw industrial-tinged rock energy from 1995's *The Warehouse Tapes*.

tracks.title: The Fortress
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Dedicated to the Tidewater and Hampton Roads fans who stood by the family from the very beginning.

tracks.title: Moon 1: Tidal Lock
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Cassidy bathes the open-air Virginia Beach grass lawn in the shimmering analog synth pads of **The Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™** under the coastal stars.

tracks.title: The Flight Path
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: **First-Ever Recorded Live Performance of *"The Flight Path"* (Mid-Concert Unannounced Mystery Song, `5:14`).** Slipped unannounced right into the middle of the set (*"We're gonna keep it moving. We've been testing this next one out on the road for the last few weeks. Let's see if you've caught on to the words yet!"*), Ryan and Cassidy test whether the Virginia Beach crowd knows the lyrics from recent tour tape-trading. All 20,000 fans at the CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater roar the chorus back at the stage, 100% convinced it is a brand-new Stardust Engine song—with no song title or mention of **Crimson Node** given! Released in February 2003 after *Crimson Node* and *Live at the Chancellery*.

tracks.title: Echoes in the Wire
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Permanently occupying the emotional ballad spotlight in place of the banned *"If You Walked Away"*.

tracks.title: No Hidden Gravity
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: A special Tidewater performance of the 1996 power ballad inspired by Hampton Roads' own Nate and Maya.

tracks.title: Redline
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: High-velocity guitar and synthesizer duel between Ryan and Cassidy.

tracks.title: My Anchor: The Sail
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: 20,000 fans from the front pit to the top of the Virginia Beach lawn sing every word of the chorus.

tracks.title: Brand New Scene
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: Closes the main set in a blaze of coastal teal and gold spotlights.

tracks.title: Electric Color
tracks.discName: Live in Virginia Beach (CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater)
tracks.loreNote: The mandatory concert closer—sending 20,000 fans out of the CTI Virginia Beach Amphitheater into the warm Tidewater night.
